name: Build APK Rotas Bus
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    tags: [ 'v*' ]
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  build:
    name: Gerar APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Baixar código
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: ☕ Configurar Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: '17'
      - name: 🔧 Configurar Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true
      - name: 🔑 Inserir chave da API
        run: |
          sed -i 's|SUA_CHAVE_AQUI|${{ secrets.GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY }}|g' android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml
      - name: 📦 Instalar pacotes
        run: flutter pub get
      - name: 🔨 Compilar APK
        run: flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi
      - name: 📎 Salvar APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: APK‑Rotas‑Bus
          path: build/app/outputs/flutter‑apk/*.apk
      - name: 🚀 Publicar Release
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        uses: ncipollo/release-action@v1
        with:
          allowUpdates: true
          generateReleaseNotes: true
          artifacts: "build/app/outputs/flutter‑apk/*.apk"
          name: Rotas Bus ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            ✅ Versão compilada automaticamente pelo GitHub Actions
            📱 Arquivos APK prontos para instalação
